replacement_cost.source_label: HVS U.S. Hotel Development Cost Survey 2026, Exhibit 6, median total incl. land

spread.missing: Not graded: trailing NOI was negative (net operating loss of $0.8M, trailing 12 months to August 2026), so there is no meaningful cap rate.

debt_context.summary: Cash sale to an unnamed third party; the hotel was unencumbered; no loan event or distress disclosed (PEB 8-K filed Oct 9, 2026).

v1.1._note: v1.1: demand graded from Oregon DOR state lodging tax, Portland Metro, FY2025 vs FY2024; publish date confirmed from the dataset's revision history. Other factors as v1.

demand.source_label: Oregon Department of Revenue, State Transient Lodging Tax Return Statistics by Region (data.oregon.gov), Portland Metro; FY2025 rows published Oct 14, 2025

demand.note: Publish date: the dataset's public revision history (data.oregon.gov/api/publishing/v1/revision/mf7n-egve) shows revision 8 replaced the data on Oct 14, 2025 with 860 rows, which is exactly the row count through FY2025; the FY2026 rows (40 more) came with revision 9 on Oct 16, 2026, after the announcement and are not used.
